summary: Calidi Biotherapeutics filed an 8-K to disclose an amended and restated warrant issued to an accredited investor. The warrant covers up to 17,391,304 shares of common stock at $0.23 per share, with exercise conditioned on stockholder approval. The amendment increases the minimum vesting acquisition amount from $500,000 to $1 million and extends the vesting termination date from July 8, 2026 to September 30, 2026. The issuance is exempt under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506(b). This is a routine equity issuance; no special situation event is present.
